@kt.kernel
def k(
    a=kt.In(64, 32, dtype="mx7a", layout={"gm": 16, "nk": 1}),
    b=kt.In(32, 32, dtype="mx7b", layout={"gn": 8, "nk": 1}),
    x=kt.In(8, 32),
    y=kt.Out(8, 32),
    m=kt.Out(8),
):
    h = kt.buffer((64, 32), "f16", tile=(16, 8))
    for u in kt.par(1, on=kt.mg):
        z = kt.zero(64, 32)
        acc = kt.gemm(kt.fill(a), kt.fill(b))
        kt.drain(acc, h)
        kt.drain(z, h)
    for c in kt.par(2, on=kt.vc):
        for t in kt.range(1):
            r = c * 4 + t * 4
            v = kt.load(x[r : r + 4, :], gt4=True)
            o = kt.where(v, v * 2.0, 0.0)
            kt.store(y[r : r + 4, :], o)
            kt.store(m[r : r + 4], kt.rsum(o))
